_purpose: Default metal-to-anchor contact distance used by `add_electrode_slab` and the Modify-tab single-mode electrode panel when the user doesn't override. One value per metal (canonical M-S thiol-anchor bond, except Pt-N where pyridine is the typical anchor).
_sources: Au-S (Au) 2.40 A: Sellers H. et al. 1993 JACS 115, 9389 (thiolate SAMs).  Ag-S 2.50 A: Yates and Houston 1985 PRB 31 6878.  Cu-S 2.30 A: Crystallographic Cu-thiolate.  Ni-S 2.20 A: Ni(II) thiolates.  Pt-N 2.05 A: Pt-pyridine.  Pd-S 2.30 A: Pd-thiolate.  All approximate room-temperature production defaults; tighten with cfg.contact_distance = ... for non-equilibrium studies.

Cu.note: Cu(I)-thiolate; tarnishes under thiol exposure -- use Au or Pt for production

Pt.note: Pt-pyridine (typical Pt anchor); for Pt-S thiolate use 2.30
